about: One terms-of-use page per portal, used when a dataset has no license of its own (issue #17). Every link is labeled 'terms page, not a license'. A portal is listed only after its page was opened: `url` is the page, `title` its exact title, `checked` the date it was opened, `found` how it was found. `kind` is 'portal' for a page the government body publishes, or 'platform' for a vendor's page that the portal itself links to. Only pages the portal links to, or that its government body publishes, are listed. `checked_without_terms` lists portals that were checked and have none, with the reason, so nobody has to check them again from scratch.
